new_result.statement: For an infinitesimal triangular array of rank-three Parseval-frame increments r_mi(X_mi-b_mi), with independent scalar densities bounded by one and a convergent latent sum, the Gaussian covariance in the infinitely-divisible limit satisfies Sigma_G >= I_3/12.
new_result.key_lemma: Every subprobability density 0<=g<=1 of mass q obeys int (x-a)^2 g(x) dx >= q^3/12; applying this to truncated scalar projections and summing by Parseval yields the Gaussian covariance floor.
new_result.scope_limit: Exact-rank-three infinitesimal spectral-frame limits with a convergent recentered latent law; does not cover macroscopic non-infinitesimal physical rows, non-tight interactions, or additional active spectrum before aggregation.

sharp_witness.description: Fully mixed tetrahedral Parseval synthesis R0 with dense Householder reflection B and iid unit-interval physical laws.
sharp_witness.principal_block_constraint: Every physical principal block of size <=m has operator norm <=3/4<1.
sharp_witness.implication: C_univ >= 3sqrt(2) in a fully mixed rotated frame, not merely disjoint banks or a diagonal control.

partner_result_applied.actual_family: Same fully mixed dense A_m, but every physical marginal has a central interval of mass 1-1/m and a root-m satellite interval of mass 1/m.
partner_result_applied.limit: G+M with G~N(0,I_3/12), M=sum_{alpha=1}^4 N_alpha r_alpha, N_alpha iid Poisson(1).

unresolved_next_step: Stress the remaining non-infinitesimal/macroscopic-row and extra-active-spectrum chambers. Seek either an overshoot above 3sqrt(2) there or a reduction that separates macroscopic coordinates and applies the Gaussian-floor theorem to the infinitesimal remainder without losing product provenance.
